title: Test command detection picks a vacuous npm workspaces command and ignores mise tasks
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16, krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac (logs .krn/tmp/s29/adopt2.log, t1.log post-adopt suite, t26.log pristine suite under the pinned Node 26: 62 pass, 2 fail only from an untrusted mise config in a temp dir).
Detection named 'npm test --workspaces --if-present' for boilerplate-2026, but no workspace has a test script (vacuous); its real test task is mise.toml [tasks."check:test"] (node --test tests/), run in CI via 'mise run check'.
Outcome: a workspaces command with no workspace test script is not a test command; a mise check:test/test task is detected as 'mise run <task>'.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/init.test.ts (or the detection test file): pass.
